title: SE Ranking MCP: Setup & Configuration
snippet:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model to access your SE Ranking and SE Visible data simply and securely.
MCP server server follows the authenticated remote MCP spec, so it’s centrally hosted and managed. Connect in one click in [Claude](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors/id/se-ranking) or [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/se-ranking), natively in Cursor and other clients, or use the `mcp-remote` module for clients that don’t support remote servers.
## What you can access
Through the MCP server, your AI assistant can work with data from these SE Ranking and SE Visible products*:
- [Data API](https://seranking.com/api/data/): keyword research, backlinks, domain analysis, SERP, and more
- [Project API](https://seranking.com/api/project/): your projects, rank tracking, audits, and competitors
- [Local Marketing API](https://seranking.com/api/local-marketing-api/): your locations, local rankings, Google Business Profile, business listings, and reviews
- [SE Visible API](https://seranking.com/api/se-visible/): your AI visibility projects, brands, topics, prompts, and sources
*The data available to you depends on your subscription. Not every API endpoint is available through MCP. Setup is the same for every product. Use your SE Ranking account, or an API key generated in the API Dashboard of your SE Ranking or SE Visible account.
## Setup Instructions
### General
Our MCP server supports Streamable HTTP transports. This transport uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for authentication at the following address:
Copy
```
https://api.seranking.com/mcp
```
Jump to your client: Claude · ChatGPT · Codex · Cursor · VS Code · v0 · Windsurf · Zed · Gemini CLI · Others.

Add the official [SE Ranking connector](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors/id/se-ranking) and click **Connect**. In Claude Desktop, you can also find it under **Customize → Connectors** by searching for *SE Ranking*.

# SEO MCP: Use SE Ranking’s live data inside any AI assistant
Put 180+ SEO and GEO tools behind every prompt: keyword data, backlinks, domain insights, audits, AI search visibility, and more — all inside your favorite AI assistant.

## Connect SE Ranking MCP in three steps
No developer, no local setup. You can be querying live data in a couple of minutes.
1
### Start your free trial
Create your account and get 100K free credits to run real queries from the start.
2
### Connect MCP to your client
Paste the MCP Server URL into Claude Code, Cursor, or any other MCP client.
3
### Authorize & start prompting
Approve the connection and ask your first SEO or GEO question in plain language.
[ Read documentation ](https://seranking.com/api/integrations/mcp/)
## Beyond SEO data: AI search visibility included
SE Ranking MCP brings traditional SEO and AI search data into one workflow. Along with keywords and backlinks, you can track domain and brand performance across leading LLM engines using plain-language prompts.
## Fast setup, live data access, multi-layer search analysis
Set up SE Ranking MCP in minutes and let your AI assistant analyze live organic and AI search data together
### Remote. Nothing to install
The MCP server is centrally hosted and managed by SE Ranking. Connect with one URL, no manual configuration required.
### Real-time data integration
Your AI assistant connects to SE Ranking in real time, so every prompt pulls the latest available data directly into the analysis.
### 180+ tools, one connection
Data across keyword research, domain analysis, backlinks, website audits, AI search visibility, and more — all in one MCP server.

An MCP server is a connector that lets AI assistants access external tools and data sources. SE Ranking MCP connects your AI assistant to live SE Ranking data (including keyword research, backlink analysis, website audits, domain analysis, and AI search visibility) so you can ask SEO and GEO questions in plain language and get data-backed answers.
Q
## Do I need a developer to set it up?
A
No. SE Ranking MCP is hosted and managed by SE Ranking. You only need to add the MCP server URL to your AI client and authorize the connection. No local installation, Docker setup, or code required. The process usually takes under two minutes.

SE Ranking MCP works with AI tools that support MCP connections, including Claude Web, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Codex, Zed, Gemini CLI, and others.

snippet: SE Ranking MCP Server This Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connects AI assistants to SE Ranking's SEO data and project management APIs. It enables natural language queries for: Keyword research and competitive analysis Backlink analysis and monitoring Domain traffic and ranking insights Website audits and technical SEO AI search visibility tracking Project and rank tracking management Prerequisites Before you begin, please ensure you have the following software and accounts ready: SE Ranking Account: You will need an active SE Ranking account to generate an API token. If you don’t have one, you can sign up here. Docker: A platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in containers. If you don’t have it, you can download it from the official Docker website. Git: A free and open-source distributed version control system. You can download it from the official Git website. AI Assistant: You will need an MCP-compatible client, such as Claude Desktop or the Gemini CLI. API Tokens This MCP server supports two types of API access: | Token | Environment Variable | Format | Purpose | | Data API | DATA_API_TOKEN | UUID (e.g., 80cfee7d-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-fc8500816bb3 ) | Access to keyword research, domain analysis, backlinks data, SERP analysis, and website audits. Tools prefixed with DATA_ . | | Project API | PROJECT_API_TOKEN | 40-char hex (e.g., 253a73adxxxxxxxxxxxx340aa0a939 ) | Access to project management, rank tracking, backlink monitoring, and account management. Tools prefixed with PROJECT_ . | Get your tokens from: https://online.seranking.com/admin.api.dashboard.html You can use one or both tokens depending on which tools you need. If you only use Data API tools, you can omit PROJECT_API_TOKEN, and vice versa. Rate Limits | API | Default Rate Limit | | Data API | 10 requests per second | | Project API | 5 requests per second | Rate limits are customizable. Contact api@seranking.com to request adjustments. Installation Choose the installation method that best fits your needs: Option 1: Docker (Recommended) - Best for standard usage, stability, and ease of updates. Use this if you just want to run the tool without managing dependencies. Option 2: Local Node.js Server (For Developers) - Best for development, debugging, or environments where Docker isn't available (like Replit).
